title: SnowFire: code and data for "Burnt wood removal reduces snow persistence after wildfire – a remote-sensing assessment"
description:
Google Earth Engine (JavaScript) and R scripts, together with the derived data, used to study snow occurrence before and after the 2005 Lanjarón wildfire (Sierra Nevada, Spain) in plots where different post-fire treatments were applied: salvage logging (SL), partial cut plus lopping (PCL) and non-intervention (NI).

The workflow includes: (1) creation of a Landsat-pixel grid and assignment of treatments; (2) calculation of the Normalized Difference Snow Index (NDSI) from Landsat 5 and 7 Collection 2 surface reflectance for cloud-free scenes; (3) extraction of ancillary variables (elevation, slope, shadows, etc.); (4) pixel-level snow percentage calculation (NDSI threshold 0.4); and (5) statistical comparison between treatments before and after the fire.
